blocker.detail: Work Cloud Browser successfully opened https://chatgpt.com/ but the page was signed out. The page explicitly says login is required to create images. Clicking Log in opened a Log in or sign up dialog with Google, Apple, phone and email sign-in methods. The supported browserAuth flow requires owner sign-in method selection and/or credentials. This attempt forbids owner intervention, so it stopped before requesting credentials or submitting the sealed prompt.

evidence.source: Work Cloud Browser initial accessibility state
evidence.observed_text: Log in to get answers based on saved chats, plus create images and upload files.

evidence.source: Work Cloud Browser accessibility state after Log in

evidence.finding: Sign-in method choices and credentials are collected from the user through a secure handoff; no autonomous saved-credential method was advertised.

stop_reason: First capability blocker: authenticated ordinary ChatGPT image creation cannot be reached under the no-owner-intervention requirement.
scope: Evidence only on the existing disposable proof branch. Existing sealed prompt, prior proof evidence, implementation, protected main and production are unchanged.
